description: A declared test population for the streaming screener — who should qualify and who should screen out. `n` is a suggestion; the CLI `--n` overrides it (keep it small with a real LLM — a pre-test makes ~one request per question per persona). Traits map onto the survey's questions (usage -> q_service_use) so synthetic answers are coherent. For TESTING incidence/logic, not a real sample. Point SURVEY_PERSONAS at a real-data source to ground it.
